title: MyContext

steps.channelDesc: Authorize a work platform so it can read your conversations and files
steps.personaDesc: Give it a name and a look
steps.sourcesDesc: Pick the time range, conversations and sources
steps.distillDesc: You can close this page; it keeps running
steps.modelDesc: Your digital twin thinks with it. Set it now or change it later in settings

channel.identityPending: Connected. We found several accounts with the same name — confirm which one is you so learning can tell apart what you said from what others said. You can continue without confirming and finish this later in Settings.
channel.identityAmbiguous: Several accounts share your name, so we can't tell which one is you automatically. Confirm it so learning can tell apart what you said from what others said. You can continue without confirming and finish this later in Settings.
channel.identityUnresolved: We couldn't determine who "you" are — the last automatic attempt didn't succeed (possibly offline at the time). Click "Resolve identity" to retry. You can continue without confirming and finish this later in Settings.
channel.identityAdoptable: This machine already has a session for {{corpName}} · {{userName}}, but this account hasn't used it yet. Click "Resolve identity" below to adopt it as you, or use "Use this identity" on the channel page.
channel.identityPendingTitle: One more step: confirm who “you” are
channel.identityReady: Connected, and we know who “you” are — this step is done.

skipHint: You can finish connecting later in Settings
restartHint: What you filled in is kept — you just walk through it again

personaStep.avatarHint: Pick hair, eyes and accessories one at a time — or hit Random for a whole new one.
personaStep.uploadedHint: Using your uploaded image; hit the button above to go back to generated figures.

figure.dropped: {{count}} item(s) could not be kept in this style
figure.droppedMany: More than {{count}} items could not be kept in this style
figure.colorNeedsPart: You turned {{part}} off, so this colour has no effect
figure.colorPartMaybeAbsent: {{part}} is left to chance right now, so it may not show up

personaStep.noPersonaHost: The digital twin currently supports DingTalk only. The name and avatar you set here are saved and take effect once DingTalk is connected.

sourcesStep.conversationHint: Leave empty to use every conversation in the time range
sourcesStep.truncatedWarning: The channel API can't return every conversation, so this list may be incomplete.
sourcesStep.memberCountUnavailable: Group size unavailable; the size filter applies only where it's known
sourcesStep.customHint: Both ends inclusive. Leave one blank to fall back to the preset.
sourcesStep.plannedExplain: Checking one remembers the choice; it starts automatically once the collector lands — no data yet.
sourcesStep.sectionRangeHint: How far back to read chat history
sourcesStep.sectionSourcesHint: Which kinds of data beyond chat messages
sourcesStep.readOnlyChannelHint: Read-only channels are not used for the digital twin's auto-replies.
sourcesStep.sourceExpired: {{channel}} sign-in has expired. Reconnect it and its conversations will show up here.
sourcesStep.sourceCannotEnumerate: This channel can't list conversations yet — nothing to pick for it here. Its conversations show up after the first read.
sourcesStep.sourceNotReady: {{channel}} is still getting ready. This will refresh on its own in a moment.

distillStep.phasesHint: Three phases in order: read your history → measure how you write → publish artifacts. All local, no model calls
distillStep.coverageBackfilling: {{selected}} days selected; the most recent {{covered}} are covered, with {{remaining}} still backfilling. You can start learning now — re-running after the backfill completes yields a more complete profile.
distillStep.coverageDone: The selected {{selected}} days have been scanned, with {{count}} chat messages currently ingested. This means collection checked the range; learning has not completed.
distillStep.coverageDoneLegacy: The selected {{selected}} days have been scanned. This means collection checked the range; learning has not completed.
distillStep.coverageNotStarted: No messages collected yet — collection may have just started, or the channel connection may be failing. Check the Status page for collection errors.
distillStep.coverageUnset: No time range set — all ingested conversation history will be used.
distillStep.metricTurnsHint: context→reply pairs. This is what the voice is measured from
distillStep.metricGradeMeaning: How many of the 11 layers had evidence — **not** whether it sounds like you (that needs a blind test).
distillStep.forgeNoAsks: No incoming asks were mined — the whole decision layer is defaults, not measurement.
distillStep.restartHint: Clears tasks and watermarks, then re-runs. Existing conclusions are kept (merging is idempotent) and nothing is duplicated.
distillStep.noModel: No model configured — only statistical tasks (active hours, response latency) will run; extraction tasks will fail. Configure an LLM in Settings → Advanced.
distillStep.graphHint: Above measures **how you write**; this records **what you talked about**. Organized automatically on launch once a model is configured
distillStep.graphBuilding: Organizing — needs a model, takes minutes. You can close this page
distillStep.graphAbsent: Not organized yet: {{reason}}. It runs automatically on next launch once a model is set.
distillStep.needPrimaryHint: Profile learning currently supports DingTalk only, and this step affects the digital twin alone. Connect DingTalk in step 1, or skip this step.
